_readme: PASTE TARGET: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json — models.providers block. PROTECTED PATHS: operator applies by hand or via Control UI (gateway config.patch refuses models.providers.*.baseUrl). Audit finding 2026-09-01 06:55Z: 4 of 5 z.ai providers point at GENERAL paas/v4 with coding-plan keys (billing pool unknown; Lite credit pools pristine despite full night of traffic = coding credits NOT consumed on those lanes). Only zai-2 is correctly on the coding endpoint. FIX (per operator law 06:42Z rule 1 'coding endpoint only'): repoint the two Lite-key providers to the coding endpoint. LEAVE zai + zai-pro on paas/v4 — they become the PAYG arms the moment standard keys (nacho $25 / fostertron $9.99) are added as env vars ZAI_PAYG_NACHO_KEY / ZAI_PAYG_FOSTERTRON_KEY and swapped into apiKey.id. Hot-reloads, no restart.
